shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git log -5 --oneline --decorate
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/messages.ts src/types/messages.test.ts .lore/dod.md
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts

sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '1,220p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/createServer.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/sessionStore.ts 2>/dev/null || true

rg -n \"specs/.*#|validated by\" src/**/*.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | head -100

rg -n \"specs/.*#\" src/transport/createServer.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts -t '"'^the websocket message handler dispatch asks the session store for the authenticated user when list_sessions is received$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts -t '"'^the websocket message handler dispatch asks the session store for the authenticated user when list_sessions is received$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"test-imports-its-subject|from '../index|from './index|public.*export\" src/*.test.ts src/**/*.test.ts | head -80

nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '68,82p'

ls scripts | rg 'reanchor' || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/messages.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts | sed -n '88,100p'
git diff --check
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts -t '"'^the websocket message handler dispatch asks the session store for the authenticated user when list_sessions is received$'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat
git diff -- src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/messages.test.ts
git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(transport): wire session store into message handler" && git push origin HEAD'
